en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.0: You should not have come here.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.1: This is not a place of honor. No great deed is commemorated here.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.3: What is here is dangerous and repulsive.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.4: We considered ourselves a powerful culture. We harnessed the hidden fire, and used it for our own purposes.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.5: Then we saw the fire could burn within living things, unnoticed until it destroyed them.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.7: We built great tombs to hold the fire for one hundred thousand years, after which it would no longer kill.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.8: If this place is opened, the fire will not be isolated from the world, and we will have failed to protect you.
en_us.message.hbm.marked_concrete.9: Leave this place and never come back.

zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.1: 这里并不是荣耀之地。这里没有纪念任何伟大事迹。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.2: 这里没有任何有价值的东西。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.3: 这里的东西危险且令人厌恶。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.4: 我们曾认为自己是强大的文明。我们驾驭了隐藏的火焰，并将它用于自己的目的。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.5: 后来我们发现，这火焰能在生物体内燃烧，直到生命被摧毁才会被察觉。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.7: 我们建造了巨大的坟墓，将这火焰封存十万年；在那之后，它才不再致命。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.8: 如果此地被打开，火焰就无法继续与外界隔绝，我们也就未能保护你。
zh_cn.message.hbm.marked_concrete.9: 离开这里，永远不要回来。
